Cascader ​

Example data, control text, messages and source comments may be in Chinese. Viewer controls and API headings use English. Untranslated API descriptions are marked.

Interactive examples, TypeScript and JavaScript source, and the generated API reference are included on this page. The native API tables on this page are translated in full; ASAM mode overrides are documented separately.

When to use it ​

Select nodes from static hierarchical options. Normalized nodes retain raw and children; successive menus display the path. ASAM value mode returns a node value rather than the full path. Choose native explicitly for native models.

Hierarchical selection and custom nodes ​

In value/object modes, the default slot receives data, node and the corresponding normalized option. Native mode forwards native data/node unchanged. filterable provides local filtering. Advanced single selection clears to null; native mode retains its native clearing value.

<template>
	<div class="example">
		<AsamCascader
			ref="control"
			v-bind="{ filterable: true, clearable: true, 'aria-label': '选择团队' }"
			v-model="value"
			:options="options"
			@change="event = JSON.stringify($event)"
		>
			<template #default="{ data }">{{ data.label }}节点</template>
			<template #empty>没有可选节点</template>
		</AsamCascader>
		<AsamButton type="primary" @click="control?.focus()">聚焦</AsamButton>
		<output>值：{{ value }}；事件：{{ event }}</output>
	</div>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamCascaderBasicExample' });
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamCascader, AsamButton } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamCascaderExpose } from '@asam-ui/ui';
const control = ref<AsamCascaderExpose>();
const options = [
	{
		label: '团队',
		value: 'team',
		raw: {},
		children: [
			{ label: '设计', value: 'design', raw: {} },
			{ label: '开发', value: 'dev', raw: {} }
		]
	}
];
const value = ref<string | null>('design');
const event = ref('尚未更改');
</script>

Try hierarchical selection.

Multiple selection and object values ​

Multiple + valueMode=object returns normalized node arrays. String storage is only for value mode; separator must not occur in values. All node values must be unique.

Raw node fields and instance ​

Native uses raw options; props.emitPath=true stores path arrays. getCheckedNodes reads selected nodes. CascaderPanel is a separate persistent panel.

Example: native

Show source
Example source ZIPComplete project ZIP
vue
<template>
	<div class="example">
		<AsamCascader
			ref="control"
			v-bind="{
				...{ 'value-mode': 'native' },
				...{
					options: nodes,
					props: { value: 'id', label: 'name', children: 'nodes', emitPath: true }
				}
			}"
			v-model="value"
		/>
		<AsamButton type="primary" @click="inspect">读取节点</AsamButton>
		<output>原始模型：{{ value }}；{{ inspected }}</output>
	</div>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamCascaderNativeExample' });
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamCascader, AsamButton } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamCascaderExpose, AsamCascaderNativeProps } from '@asam-ui/ui';
const control = ref<AsamCascaderExpose>();
const value = ref<AsamCascaderNativeProps['modelValue']>([]);
const nodes = [
	{
		id: 'team',
		name: '团队',
		nodes: [
			{ id: 'design', name: '设计' },
			{ id: 'dev', name: '开发' }
		]
	}
];
const inspected = ref('');
function inspect() {
	inspected.value = JSON.stringify(
		control.value?.getCheckedNodes(true)?.map((node) => node.value)
	);
}
</script>

Sizes and inheritance ​

Four examples explicitly use large/big/default/small. An instance without size follows ConfigProvider changes; explicit size overrides ancestors. Panels without a size contract do not acquire an extra size prop.

ASAM extensions and migration ​

ASAM adds four densities and value/object, array/string policies. Static components do not handle request/dictType. Unresolved selections retain their display and are resolved again when options arrive. Native mode uses raw options/data and field mapping, without normalized string storage. TreeSelect provides public tree methods; Cascader provides focus/blur, checked-node access and popup operations.

update:modelValue and change infer their payload from valueMode, top-level or nested multiple, and multipleValueMode. Single values return node values or null; single objects return normalized nodes or null; multiple selection returns writable value/object arrays; string storage returns string and clears to ''. CamelCase and kebab-case props follow the same constraints. Single-selection refs must allow null; do not replace a specific mode with an all-mode union. Native retains its declared model union and clear value. Initial arrays in path/multiple examples are not all possible outputs. Narrow TS examples are directly reusable.

Native TS parent models use ref<AsamCascaderNativeProps['modelValue']> to retain scalar, path, multiple and empty declarations; an initial [] must not infer never[] or only paths. Helper Checkbox models use their public event argument types. Convert Switch output explicitly before passing it to boolean props.

The obsolete popper-append-to-body is absent. teleported controls whether the popup is transferred out of its original location (default true); false keeps it local. appendTo/append-to specifies a transfer target on entries that support it. The pinned Cascader does not expose it: do not pass it to Cascader. It differs from the teleported toggle.

Controlled write-back boundaries ​

Clicking a node in an open panel produces a candidate and emits update:modelValue and change. On 2.14.7, if the host ignores it or transforms it back to an unchanged previous model, a persistent=true panel may continue showing the candidate and getCheckedNodes may return it. Closing/reopening does not automatically roll back. This was observed with native Cascader and ASAM native/value/object. An unchanged host model does not prove the UI reset.

When the parent supplies an actually changed modelValue, the native component resynchronizes display and nodes. persistent=false destroys the panel on close. CascaderPanelRef and getCheckedNodes follow that native lifecycle. ASAM keeps no separate selection snapshot and adds no tag-removal or controlled-rollback algorithm. The strategy example compares host model, actual display and public nodes.

SSR limitations ​

Advanced lazy prefilled unresolved scalars share native synchronization limits. If a leaf cannot be resolved before loading, its label and checked nodes may remain missing afterwards. ASAM retains host values and unresolved decorations without briefly rebinding modelValue. Supply resolvable initial options, or an actually changed host model after loading, when the leaf must display as selected.

On 2.14.7, repeated SSR rendering of persistent=true Cascader popups in one server process can produce node DOM-id hydration mismatches. Native and ASAM Cascader both reproduced this. First hydration checks covered the same fresh SSR application, not a guarantee for repeated requests. Correct values and labels do not prove hydration is warning-free.

Reading the API ​

Generated props, Events, Slots and Exposes use current public types and runtime defaults. Combined props apply by branch; unknown or undeclared defaults do not mean false or empty. Standalone Demo.vue source inlines local helpers, data and assets.

Complete native usage and API ​

The following targets pinned 2.14.7. Cascader/TreeSelect examples explicitly use value-mode=native; native values, paths, mapping and callbacks cannot be transplanted directly into normalized modes. Native tables retain native defaults; ASAM overrides and four-size rules follow the sections below. Use a cascader to browse and select a clearly hierarchical dataset.

Basic usage ​

Supply an options array. props.expandTrigger selects either click or hover to open child menus.

Disabled options ​

Set disabled=true in source items. The example disables the first option. The default field is disabled; use props.disabled for another field name. Value, label and children can be mapped the same way.

Try the last-level display.

Multiple selection ​

Use native mode with props.multiple=true. Keep the configuration in a named object for reuse:

vue
<template>
	<AsamCascader value-mode="native" :props="props" />
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { AsamCascader } from '@asam-ui/ui';
const props = { multiple: true };
</script>

All selected tags display by default. Enable collapse-tags to collapse them. Max-collapse-tags controls the visible count (default 1); collapse-tags-tooltip shows the selected values on hover.

Example: native-multiple-selection

Selecting any level ​

Normally single selection chooses leaves, while checking a parent in multiple mode selects its leaves. props.checkStrictly=true disconnects parent/child selection so any level can be selected.

Example: native-any-level

Try any-level selection.

Dynamic loading ​

Enable lazy and supply lazyLoad to fetch children when a level is selected. It receives node and the required resolve callback. A leaf flag, default leaf or mapped through props.leaf, improves node-state accuracy. Otherwise leaf status is inferred from children.

Example: native-dynamic-loading

Show source
LicenseExample source ZIPComplete project ZIP
vue
<template>
	<AsamCascader value-mode="native" :props="props" />
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>


import { AsamCascader } from '@asam-ui/ui';
// Adapted from the fixed upstream MIT example: cascader/dynamic-loading.vue

import type { AsamCascaderNativeConfig } from '@asam-ui/ui';

let id = 0;
const props: AsamCascaderNativeConfig = {
	lazy: true,
	lazyLoad(node, resolve) {
		const { level } = node;
		setTimeout(() => {
			const nodes = Array.from({ length: level + 1 }).map(() => ({
				value: ++id,
				label: `Option - ${id}`,
				leaf: level >= 2
			}));
			// Invoke `resolve` callback to return the child nodes data and indicate the loading is finished.
			resolve(nodes);
		}, 1000);
	}
};
</script>
LicenseExample source ZIPComplete project ZIP
vue
<template>
	<AsamCascader value-mode="native" :props="props" />
</template>

<script setup>


import { AsamCascader } from '@asam-ui/ui';
let id = 0;
const props = {
	lazy: true,
	lazyLoad(node, resolve) {
		const { level } = node;
		setTimeout(() => {
			const nodes = Array.from({ length: level + 1 }).map(() => ({
				value: ++id,
				label: `Option - ${id}`,
				leaf: level >= 2
			}));
			// Invoke `resolve` callback to return the child nodes data and indicate the loading is finished.
			resolve(nodes);
		}, 1000);
	}
};
</script>

Try dynamic loading.

Filtering ​

filterable enables quick search. Native mode matches node/ancestor labels according to show-all-levels. Filter-method receives node and keyword and returns a boolean match.

Example: native-filterable

Cascader panel ​

The core panel supports single/multiple selection and dynamic loading. Like native AsamCascader, AsamCascaderPanel receives options and configures node behavior through props. See Cascader panel for its API and standalone example.

Custom tags ​

The tag slot customizes tags. Custom rendering replaces collapse-tags, collapse-tags-tooltip and max-collapse-tags behavior.

Example: native-custom-tag

Show source
LicenseExample source ZIPComplete project ZIP
vue
<template>
	<div class="m-4">
		<p class="example-paragraph">使用插槽可以更灵活地控制展示。</p>
		<AsamCascader value-mode="native" :options="options" :props="props" clearable>
			<template #tag="{ data }">
				<AsamTag
					v-for="(item, index) in getTags(data)"
					:key="item"
					:color="index % 2 === 0 ? '#FFDE0A' : ''"
				>
					{{ item }}
				</AsamTag>
			</template>
		</AsamCascader>
		<p class="example-paragraph">仅显示顶层标签</p>
		<AsamCascader value-mode="native" :options="options" :props="props" clearable>
			<template #tag="{ data }">
				<AsamTag v-for="item in getTopLevelTags(data)" :key="item">
					{{ item }}
				</AsamTag>
			</template>
		</AsamCascader>
	</div>
</template>

<template>
	<section class="controlled-boundary">
		<h3>常驻面板的受控回写边界</h3>
		<p class="example-paragraph">
			初始宿主值为3。选择节点2后，忽略回写或第一次转换回旧值3时，常驻面板可能保留候选2。
			关闭再打开不会自动回滚；随后将宿主改为4，可观察真实新值的同步。
		</p>
		<label>
			值模式
			<AsamSelect v-model="mode" @change="resetLog">
				<AsamOption value="native" :label="'native'">native</AsamOption>
				<AsamOption value="value" :label="'value'">value</AsamOption>
				<AsamOption value="object" :label="'object'">object</AsamOption>
			</AsamSelect>
		</label>
		<label>
			宿主回写
			<AsamSelect v-model="behavior" @change="resetLog">
				<AsamOption value="accept" :label="'接受候选值'">接受候选值</AsamOption>
				<AsamOption value="reject" :label="'忽略回写'">忽略回写</AsamOption>
				<AsamOption value="transform" :label="'非幂等转换：依次返回3、2、3'">
					非幂等转换：依次返回3、2、3
				</AsamOption>
			</AsamSelect>
		</label>
		<div class="boundary-actions">
			<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="closePanel">
				关闭面板
			</AsamButton>
			<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="openPanel">重新打开</AsamButton>
			<AsamButton type="primary" native-type="button" @click="readDisplay">
				读取显示与节点
			</AsamButton>
			<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="setParent">
				宿主改为4
			</AsamButton>
		</div>
		<AsamCascader
			v-if="mode === 'native'"
			ref="control"
			value-mode="native"
			:model-value="nativeModel"
			:options="boundaryOptions"
			:props="configuration"
			:persistent="true"
			@update:model-value="updateNative"
			@change="record('change', $event)"
		/>
		<AsamCascader
			v-else-if="mode === 'value'"
			ref="control"
			value-mode="value"
			:model-value="valueModel"
			:options="boundaryOptions"
			:props="configuration"
			:persistent="true"
			@update:model-value="updateValue"
			@change="record('change', $event)"
		/>
		<AsamCascader
			v-else
			ref="control"
			value-mode="object"
			:model-value="objectModel"
			:options="boundaryOptions"
			:props="configuration"
			:persistent="true"
			@update:model-value="updateObject"
			@change="record('change', $event)"
		/>
		<output class="boundary-model">宿主模型：{{ model }}</output>
		<output class="boundary-display">
			实际显示：{{ display.text }}；公开节点：{{ display.nodes }}；面板存在：{{
				display.panel
			}}
		</output>
		<output class="boundary-events">模型事件：{{ events }}</output>
		<output class="boundary-transformations">转换调用：{{ transformations }}</output>
	</section>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { computed, nextTick, ref, unref } from 'vue';
import { AsamSelect, AsamOption, AsamButton, AsamCascader } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamCascaderExpose, AsamCascaderNativeProps, AsamHierarchyOption } from '@asam-ui/ui';

const mode = ref<'native' | 'value' | 'object'>('native');
const behavior = ref<'accept' | 'reject' | 'transform'>('reject');
const configuration = { multiple: false, emitPath: false } as const;
const children = [
	{ value: 2, label: '节点2', raw: { id: 2 } },
	{ value: 3, label: '节点3', raw: { id: 3 } },
	{ value: 4, label: '节点4', raw: { id: 4 } }
];
const boundaryOptions = [{ value: 1, label: '根节点', raw: { id: 1 }, children }];
const nativeModel = ref<AsamCascaderNativeProps['modelValue']>(3);
const valueModel = ref<AsamHierarchyOption['value'] | null>(3);
const objectModel = ref<AsamHierarchyOption | null>(children[1]);
const control = ref<AsamCascaderExpose>();
const transformations = ref(0);
const events = ref<{ name: string; value: unknown }[]>([]);
const display = ref<{ text: string; nodes: unknown[]; panel: boolean }>({
	text: '',
	nodes: [],
	panel: false
});
const model = computed(() =>
	mode.value === 'native'
		? nativeModel.value
		: mode.value === 'value'
			? valueModel.value
			: objectModel.value
);
async function readDisplay() {
	await nextTick();
	display.value = {
		text: unref(control.value?.presentText) ?? '',
		nodes: control.value?.getCheckedNodes(true)?.map((node) => node.value) ?? [],
		panel: !!control.value?.cascaderPanelRef
	};
}
function record(name: string, value: unknown) {
	events.value.push({ name, value });
	void readDisplay();
}
function transformedValue() {
	return ++transformations.value % 2 ? 3 : 2;
}
function updateNative(value: AsamCascaderNativeProps['modelValue']) {
	record('update:modelValue', value);
	if (behavior.value !== 'reject')
		nativeModel.value = behavior.value === 'transform' ? transformedValue() : value;
}
function updateValue(value: AsamHierarchyOption['value'] | null) {
	record('update:modelValue', value);
	if (behavior.value !== 'reject')
		valueModel.value = behavior.value === 'transform' ? transformedValue() : value;
}
function updateObject(value: AsamHierarchyOption | null) {
	record('update:modelValue', value);
	if (behavior.value === 'reject') return;
	const transformed = behavior.value === 'transform' ? transformedValue() : undefined;
	objectModel.value =
		transformed === undefined
			? value
			: (children.find((option) => option.value === transformed) ?? null);
}
function resetLog() {
	events.value = [];
	transformations.value = 0;
	void readDisplay();
}
async function closePanel() {
	control.value?.togglePopperVisible(false);
	await readDisplay();
}
async function openPanel() {
	control.value?.togglePopperVisible(true);
	await readDisplay();
}
async function setParent() {
	nativeModel.value = 4;
	valueModel.value = 4;
	objectModel.value = children[2];
	await readDisplay();
}
</script>

}

output {

}

const nativeModel = ref(3);
const valueModel = ref(3);
const objectModel = ref(children[1]);
const control = ref();
const transformations = ref(0);
const events = ref([]);
const display = ref({
	text: '',
	nodes: [],
	panel: false
});
const model = computed(() =>
	mode.value === 'native'
		? nativeModel.value
		: mode.value === 'value'
			? valueModel.value
			: objectModel.value
);
async function readDisplay() {
	await nextTick();
	display.value = {
		text: unref(control.value?.presentText) ?? '',
		nodes: control.value?.getCheckedNodes(true)?.map((node) => node.value) ?? [],
		panel: !!control.value?.cascaderPanelRef
	};
}
function record(name, value) {
	events.value.push({ name, value });
	void readDisplay();
}
function transformedValue() {
	return ++transformations.value % 2 ? 3 : 2;
}
function updateNative(value) {
	record('update:modelValue', value);
	if (behavior.value !== 'reject')
		nativeModel.value = behavior.value === 'transform' ? transformedValue() : value;
}
function updateValue(value) {
	record('update:modelValue', value);
	if (behavior.value !== 'reject')
		valueModel.value = behavior.value === 'transform' ? transformedValue() : value;
}
function updateObject(value) {
	record('update:modelValue', value);
	if (behavior.value === 'reject') return;
	const transformed = behavior.value === 'transform' ? transformedValue() : undefined;
	objectModel.value =
		transformed === undefined
			? value
			: (children.find((option) => option.value === transformed) ?? null);
}
function resetLog() {
	events.value = [];
	transformations.value = 0;
	void readDisplay();
}
async function closePanel() {
	control.value?.togglePopperVisible(false);
	await readDisplay();
}
async function openPanel() {
	control.value?.togglePopperVisible(true);
	await readDisplay();
}
async function setParent() {
	nativeModel.value = 4;
	valueModel.value = 4;
	objectModel.value = children[2];
	await readDisplay();
}
</script>

Compare strategies and controlled write-back.

The first two multiple examples explicitly set persistent=false and prefill native paths. Closing destroys the popup; reopening rebuilds it from the current host value. Parent/child retain their strategies. Closed-state tags, deletion, clearing and getCheckedNodes follow the current public instance; a destroyed panel does not guarantee a node snapshot. Rejected write-back follows native display behavior.

The controlled example fixes persistent=true, compares native/value/object and host acceptance, ignoring and non-idempotent transformation. It separately shows model, actual display, public nodes and events. Select node 2 to observe ignoring or the first transformation back to old value 3. Close/reopen, then actually change the host to 4 to observe synchronization. Buttons only call public popup methods or change the host model, without changing persistent or forcing remounts to roll back.

Clicking nodes to select ​

With multiple or checkStrictly enabled, checkOnClickNode lets node clicks toggle selection as well as prefix icons. showPrefix controls prefix visibility. checkOnClickLeaf controls selection on leaf clicks and defaults to true.

Custom header and footer ​

Use header/footer slots to supply dropdown content.

Show source

vue
<template>
	<div class="cascader-custom-header-footer demo-layout-1">
		<div class="demo-layout-2">
			<p class="example-paragraph">自定义头部内容</p>
			<AsamCascader
				value-mode="native"
				v-model="value"
				popper-class="cascader-custom-header"
				:options="options"
				:props="props"
				clearable
			>
				<template #header>
					<AsamCheckboxItem
						v-model="checkAll"
						:indeterminate="indeterminate"
						@change="handleCheckAll"
					>
						全部
					</AsamCheckboxItem>
				</template>
			</AsamCascader>
		</div>
		<div class="demo-layout-3">
			<p class="example-paragraph">自定义底部内容</p>
			<AsamCascader
				value-mode="native"
				v-model="value"
				:options="options"
				:props="props"
				clearable
			>
				<template #footer>
					<AsamButton type="default" link size="small" @click="handleClear">
						清除
					</AsamButton>
				</template>
			</AsamCascader>
		</div>
	</div>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>


import { AsamCascader, AsamCheckboxItem, AsamButton } from '@asam-ui/ui';
// Adapted from the fixed upstream MIT example: cascader/custom-header-footer.vue

import { computed, ref, watch } from 'vue';

import type {
	AsamCascaderOption,
	AsamCascaderNativeProps,
	AsamCheckboxItemEmits
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
type CheckboxValueType = string | number | boolean;

const props = { multiple: true };
const checkAll = ref<AsamCheckboxItemEmits['update:modelValue'][0]>(false);
const indeterminate = ref(false);
const value = ref<AsamCascaderNativeProps['modelValue']>([]);
const options = ref([
	{
		value: 'guide',
		label: '指南',
		children: [
			{
				value: 'disciplines',
				label: 'Disciplines',
				children: [
					{ value: 'consistency', label: '一致性' },
					{ value: 'feedback', label: '反馈' },
					{ value: 'efficiency', label: '效率' },
					{ value: 'controllability', label: '可控性' }
				]
			}
		]
	}
]);

const getAllValuePaths = computed(() => {
	const result: string[][] = [];
	const queue: { node: AsamCascaderOption; path: string[] }[] = options.value.map((node) => ({
		node,
		path: [node.value]
	}));

	while (queue.length > 0) {
		const { node, path } = queue.shift()!;
		if (node.children?.length) {
			node.children.forEach((child) => {
				queue.push({ node: child, path: [...path, child.value as string] });
			});
		} else {
			result.push(path);
		}
	}
	return result;
});

watch(value, (val) => {
	const count = Array.isArray(val) ? val.length : 0;
	if (count === 0) {
		checkAll.value = false;
		indeterminate.value = false;
	} else if (count === getAllValuePaths.value.length) {
		checkAll.value = true;
		indeterminate.value = false;
	} else {
		indeterminate.value = true;
	}
});

const handleCheckAll = (val: CheckboxValueType) => {
	indeterminate.value = false;
	value.value = val ? getAllValuePaths.value : [];
};

const handleClear = () => {
	value.value = [];
};
</script>

Virtual scrolling ​

Enable virtual-scroll for large datasets. height sets menu height (default 204 px); item-size sets node height (default 34 px).

Example: native-virtual-scroll

Show source
LicenseExample source ZIPComplete project ZIP
vue
<template>
	<AsamCascader
		value-mode="native"
		v-model="value"
		:options="options"
		:filter-method="filterMethod"
		filterable
		virtual-scroll
		clearable
		placeholder="大数据量选择器"
	/>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>


import { AsamCascader } from '@asam-ui/ui';
// Adapted from the fixed upstream MIT example: cascader/virtual-scroll.vue

import { ref } from 'vue';

import type { AsamCascaderNode, AsamCascaderNativeProps } from '@asam-ui/ui';

interface CascaderExampleOption {
	value: string;
	label: string;
	children?: CascaderExampleOption[];
}

const value = ref<AsamCascaderNativeProps['modelValue']>([]);

const filterMethod = (node: AsamCascaderNode, keyword: string) => {
	return node.text.toLowerCase().includes(keyword.toLowerCase());
};

const generateOptions = (count: number): CascaderExampleOption[] => {
	return Array.from({ length: count }).map((_, index) => ({
		value: `option-${index}`,
		label: `Option ${index + 1}`,
		children: [
			{
				value: `child-${index}-1`,
				label: `Child ${index + 1}-1`,
				children: [
					{
						value: `grandchild-${index}-1-1`,
						label: `Grandchild ${index + 1}-1-1`
					},
					{
						value: `grandchild-${index}-1-2`,
						label: `Grandchild ${index + 1}-1-2`
					}
				]
			},
			{
				value: `child-${index}-2`,
				label: `Child ${index + 1}-2`
			}
		]
	}));
};

const options = ref<CascaderExampleOption[]>(generateOptions(20000));
</script>

Suggestion width ​

By default, filtering suggestions use the maximum matching-option width. Custom suggestion-item content may differ from label and make this calculation inaccurate. Fit-input-width fixes the width; a number specifies pixels. It affects only the search suggestion panel, not ordinary cascader menus.

Example: native-fit-input-width

Show source
LicenseExample source ZIPComplete project ZIP
vue
<template>
	<div class="flex flex-wrap gap-4 items-center">
		<AsamCascader
			value-mode="native"
			v-model="value"
			:options="options"
			placeholder="默认展开面板"
			filterable
		/>

		<AsamCascader
			value-mode="native"
			v-model="value"
			:options="options"
			placeholder="匹配输入框宽度"
			filterable
			fit-input-width
		/>

Cascader API ​

props ​

Name Description Type Default
model-value / v-model Bound selected value. string / number /arraystring[] | number[] | any —
options Source options; customize value and label with CascaderProps. arrayAsamCascaderOption[] —
props Node behavior configuration; see CascaderProps below. objectCascaderProps —
size Input size. This native table omits ASAM big; see ASAM sizes below. enum'large' | 'default' | 'small' —
placeholder Input placeholder. string —
disabled Disabled state. boolean —
clearable Allow clearing selected options. boolean —
clear-icon Custom clear icon. string / objectComponent CircleClose
show-all-levels Show the complete selected path in the input. boolean true
collapse-tags Collapse tags in multiple-selection mode. boolean —
collapse-tags-tooltip Show all selected tags when hovering collapsed text; requires collapse-tags=true. boolean false
max-collapse-tags-tooltip-height Maximum height of the collapsed-tag tooltip. string / number —
separator Separator between path labels. string ' / '
filterable Enable searching options. boolean —
filter-method Custom matching: receives node and keyword; return true to retain the option. Function(node: AsamCascaderNode, keyword: string) => boolean —
debounce Search-input debounce delay in milliseconds. number 300
before-filter Hook before filtering, receiving the query. False or a rejected Promise prevents filtering. Function(value: string) => boolean —
popper-class Custom class for the dropdown and tag tooltip. string ''
popper-style Custom style for the dropdown and tag tooltip. string / object —
teleported Teleport the popup. boolean true
effect Tooltip theme: built-in dark/light or a custom name. enum'dark' | 'light' / string light
tag-type Tag type. enum'success' | 'info' | 'warning' | 'danger' info
tag-effect Tag effect. enum'light' | 'dark' | 'plain' light
validate-event Trigger form validation. boolean true
max-collapse-tags Maximum visible tag count; requires collapse-tags=true. number 1
empty-values Empty-value set; see ConfigProvider. array —
value-on-clear Clearing return value; see ConfigProvider. string / number / boolean / Function —
persistent With false, remove the dropdown container when inactive. boolean true
fallback-placements Fallback tooltip placements; see Popper flip. arrayPlacement[] —
placement Dropdown placement. enum'top' | 'top-start' | 'top-end' | 'bottom' | 'bottom-start' | 'bottom-end' | 'left' | 'left-start' | 'left-end' | 'right' | 'right-start' | 'right-end' bottom-start
show-checked-strategy Multiple-selection display strategy: parent for compact display, child for individual children. enum'parent' | 'child' child
virtual-scroll Enable virtual scrolling for large datasets. boolean false
fit-input-width Align suggestion width with the input; a number fixes its pixel width. boolean / number false
item-size Virtual node height in pixels. number 34
height Virtual menu height in pixels. number 204

Events ​

Name Description Type
change Fires when the bound value changes. Function(value: AsamCascaderNativeProps['modelValue']) => void
expand-change Fires when expanded nodes change. Function(value: AsamCascaderNativeProps['modelValue']) => void
blur Fires on blur. Function(event: FocusEvent) => void
focus Fires on focus. Function(event: FocusEvent) => void
clear Fires when the user clears a clearable single selection. Function() => void
visible-change Fires when the dropdown opens or closes. Function(value: boolean) => void
remove-tag Fires when a tag is removed in multiple-selection mode. Function(value: AsamCascaderNode['valueByOption']) => void

Slots ​

Name Description Type
default Custom child-node content; scope contains the node object and node data. object{ node: any, data: any }
empty Content when no options match. —
prefix Input prefix content. —
suggestion-item Custom search suggestion content. object{ item: AsamCascaderNode }
tag Custom tag rendering. object{ data: AsamCascaderTag[], deleteTag: (tag: AsamCascaderTag) => void }
header Content above the dropdown list. —
footer Content below the dropdown list. —

Instance methods and state ​

Name Description Type
getCheckedNodes Return current checked nodes; leafOnly restricts results to leaves and defaults to false. Function(leafOnly: boolean) => AsamCascaderNode[] | undefined
cascaderPanelRef Cascader panel reference. objectComputedRef<any>
togglePopperVisible Toggle popup visibility. Function(visible?: boolean) => void
contentRef Cascader content reference. objectComputedRef<any>
presentText Selected display text. objectComputedRef<string>
focus Focus the input. Function() => void
blur Blur the input. Function() => void

CascaderProps ​

Name Description Type Default
expandTrigger How child menus expand. enum'click' | 'hover' click
multiple Enable multiple selection. boolean false
checkStrictly Keep parent and child checked states independent. boolean false
emitPath Emit the complete path when a selection changes; false returns only the node value. boolean true
lazy load children dynamically; use with lazyLoad. boolean false
lazyLoad load child data when lazy=true. The reject callback rejects loading. Function(node: Node, resolve: Resolve, reject: () => void) => void —
value Field containing an option value. string value
label Field containing a node label. string label
children Field containing child options. string children
disabled Field containing the disabled flag. string disabled
leaf Field containing the leaf flag. string leaf
hoverThreshold Hover expansion sensitivity threshold. number 500
checkOnClickNode Toggle checking when clicking a node. boolean false
checkOnClickLeaf Toggle checking when clicking a leaf node. boolean true
showPrefix Show radio/checkbox prefix icons. boolean true

ASAM modes and defaults ​

Default valueMode=value returns leaf/node values and clears single selections to null. Object mode returns normalized nodes with raw; multiple selection clears to []. Zero, false and empty strings are valid. Normalized Cascader fixes emitPath=false; use native for complete paths. Explicit top-level multiple wins; otherwise props.multiple applies. TreeSelect defaults checkStrictly=true, with explicit false restoring parent/child linkage. Multiple TreeSelect shows checkboxes by default; showCheckbox=false hides them.

Normalized multiple selection defaults to arrays. Value mode permits explicit multipleValueMode=string with separator. Separators must be nonempty and absent from values; serialized tokens across the whole tree must not collide. Object/native reject string storage. Unknown selected values remain available for restoration. Loaded nodes provide labels without rewriting old host objects. Loader/options/valueMode changes isolate late callbacks.

Sizes are large/big/default/small with ConfigProvider inheritance. Native tables list underlying large/default/small, not the complete ASAM set. Base components accept options or host lazy callbacks. Remote/Dict entries own providers, searches and complete-tree retrieval.

Normalized lazy loading ​

load/lazyLoad returns { value, label, raw, children?, leaf?, isLeaf? }, not arbitrary native records. Cascader reads leaf; TreeSelect reads isLeaf. Map through props.leaf/props.isLeaf; extra business fields can come from raw. Internal keys are typed strings while business v-model retains original values; native uses raw keys. Each resolve is accepted once. Duplicate values, cyclic trees and invalid string serialization throw type errors. Reject preserves native retry semantics. Recreating inline props without changing the loader does not reinitialize dynamic nodes. validateEvent=false stops wrapper change validation; native form disabled inheritance remains.

vue
<template>
	<div class="hierarchy-example">
		<p class="example-paragraph">
			依次展开“根节点”和子节点，加载两层；数字 0、false 与空字符串保留原类型。
		</p>
		<label>
			value
			<AsamCascader v-model="value" :props="{ lazy: true, lazyLoad: load }" clearable />
		</label>
		<label>
			object
			<AsamCascader
				v-model="objectValue"
				value-mode="object"
				:props="{ lazy: true, lazyLoad: load }"
				clearable
			/>
		</label>
		<label>
			多选
			<AsamCascader
				v-model="multiple"
				multiple
				:props="{ lazy: true, lazyLoad: load }"
				clearable
			/>
		</label>
		<label>
			字符串存储
			<AsamCascader
				v-model="tokens"
				multiple
				multiple-value-mode="string"
				:options="stringOptions"
			/>
		</label>
		<div>
			<AsamButton type="default" @click="restore">回填数字 0</AsamButton>
			<AsamButton type="default" @click="clear">清空</AsamButton>
			<AsamButton type="default" @click="replace">切换源并丢弃迟到回调</AsamButton>
		</div>
		<output>
			源 {{ version }}；value={{ JSON.stringify(value) }}；object={{
				JSON.stringify(objectValue)
			}}；multiple={{ JSON.stringify(multiple) }}；tokens={{ tokens }}
		</output>
	</div>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { computed, ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamCascader, AsamButton } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamCascaderLazyLoad, AsamHierarchyOption, AsamValue } from '@asam-ui/ui';
const version = ref(1);
const value = ref<AsamValue | null>(null);
const objectValue = ref<AsamHierarchyOption | null>(null);
const multiple = ref<AsamValue[]>([]);
const tokens = ref('');
const stringOptions = [
	{ value: 1, label: '一', raw: {} },
	{ value: 2, label: '二', raw: {} }
];
const load = computed<AsamCascaderLazyLoad>(() => {
	const sourceVersion = version.value;
	return (node, resolve) => {
		setTimeout(() => {
			resolve(
				node.level === 0
					? [
							{
								value: 'root',
								label: '根节点 ' + sourceVersion,
								raw: { sourceVersion },
								leaf: false,
								isLeaf: false
							}
						]
					: [0, false, ''].map((value) => ({
							value,
							label:
								typeof value +
								':' +
								JSON.stringify(value) +
								' / 源' +
								sourceVersion,
							raw: { sourceVersion },
							leaf: true,
							isLeaf: true
						}))
			);
		}, 400);
	};
});
function restore() {
	value.value = 0;
	objectValue.value = { value: 0, label: '回填 0', raw: { restored: true } };
}
function clear() {
	value.value = null;
	objectValue.value = null;
	multiple.value = [];
	tokens.value = '';
}
function replace() {
	clear();
	version.value++;
}
</script>

<style scoped>
.hierarchy-example {
	display: grid;
	gap: var(--asam-space-md);
}

label {
	display: flex;
	align-items: center;
	gap: var(--asam-space-sm);
}

output {
	overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
</style>

<style scoped>
p:where(.example-paragraph) {
	margin-block: 16px;
	line-height: 1.8;
	overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
</style>

Local and global mounting ​

Change public mounting settings, then open the popup to see it near the component or in body. The switch shows the current mode; both work and can be changed again after closing.

API reference

Props AsamCascaderProps

NameDescriptionTypeDefault
optionsSee the full description below. Detailsreadonly AsamHierarchyOption<V, I>[] | undefined | AsamCascaderOption[] | undefined() => []
separatoroption label separatorstring | undefinedundefined
disabledwhether Cascader is disabledboolean | undefinedundefined
placeholderplaceholder of inputstring | undefinedundefined
filterablewhether the options can be searchedboolean | undefinedfalse
clearablewhether selected value can be clearedboolean | undefinedtrue
teleportedwhether cascader popup is teleportedboolean | undefinedtrue
